args.body: Issue 4206 reports that when two transactions have the same date, amount, and description but different currencies (one EUR and one USD), only one of them is included in the exported CSV file. This pull request proposes a change in `src/export/csv.ts` to ensure that both transactions are correctly exported, maintaining their currency distinctions, thus preventing data loss in the CSV output.
